question: Which circulars refer to the Securities and Exchange Board of India Act, 1992?
verify_cypher: MATCH (c:Circular)-[:CONTAINS]->(:Clause)-[]->(:Entity {name:'Securities and Exchange Board of India Act, 1992'}) RETURN DISTINCT split(c.id,'/')[-2]+'/'+split(c.id,'/')[-1] AS circular, c.date AS date

question: Which circular references the Information Technology Act, 2000?
expected: Only HO/19/34/14(8)2026-AFD-POD2/I/19251/2026 (the August 20, 2026 circular on digitally signed Power of Attorney from FPIs).
verify_cypher: MATCH (c:Circular)-[:CONTAINS]->(:Clause)-[]->(e:Entity) WHERE e.name STARTS WITH 'Information Technology Act' RETURN DISTINCT split(c.id,'/')[-2]+'/'+split(c.id,'/')[-1] AS circular

question: Which circulars refer to the SEBI (Foreign Portfolio Investors) Regulations, 2019?
verify_cypher: MATCH (c:Circular)-[:CONTAINS]->(:Clause)-[]->(:Entity {name:'SEBI (Foreign Portfolio Investors) Regulations, 2019'}) RETURN DISTINCT split(c.id,'/')[-2]+'/'+split(c.id,'/')[-1] AS circular

question: Which circulars modify the FPI Master Circular?
expected: Three circulars: HO/19/34/14(8)2026-AFD-POD2/I/19251/2026 (Aug 20, 2026, Para 9(B)(iv) of Part B), HO/(485)2026-AFD-POD2/I/20296/2026 (Sep 7, 2026, FPIs investing only in Government Securities) and HO/19/34/14(10)2026-AFD-POD3/I/24814/2026 (Oct 30, 2026, KYC review periodicity).
verify_cypher: MATCH (c:Circular)-[:CONTAINS]->(:Clause)-[:MODIFIES]->(:Entity {name:'FPI Master Circular'}) RETURN DISTINCT split(c.id,'/')[-2]+'/'+split(c.id,'/')[-1] AS circular, c.date AS date

question: Which regulations does the debenture trustee timeline extension circular refer to?
expected: SEBI (Debenture Trustees) Regulations, 1993 and SEBI (Debenture Trustees) (Amendment) Regulations, 2025.
verify_cypher: MATCH (c:Circular)-[:CONTAINS]->(:Clause)-[]->(e:Entity {type:'regulation'}) WHERE c.id ENDS WITH '24467/2026' RETURN DISTINCT e.name AS regulation

question: Which earlier SEBI circulars does the debenture trustee circular refer to?
expected: The SEBI circular HO/17/11/12(3)2025-DDHS-POD1/I/146/2025 dated November 25, 2025, and the SEBI circular dated April 28, 2026.
verify_cypher: MATCH (c:Circular)-[:CONTAINS]->(:Clause)-[]->(e:Entity {type:'circular'}) WHERE c.id ENDS WITH '24467/2026' RETURN DISTINCT e.name AS circular

question: How many circulars are in the knowledge graph?
What is the subject of the circular issued on October 30, 2026?
expected: Rationalisation of periodicity of KYC review for FPIs (HO/19/34/14(10)2026-AFD-POD3/I/24814/2026).
verify_cypher: MATCH (c:Circular {date:'October 30, 2026'}) RETURN c.id AS id, c.subject AS subject

question: Does any circular in the graph reference the Companies Act, 2013?
expected: No. None of the circulars reference the Companies Act, 2013.
verify_cypher: MATCH (e:Entity) WHERE toLower(e.name) CONTAINS 'companies act' OR any(a IN coalesce(e.aliases, []) WHERE toLower(a) CONTAINS 'companies act') RETURN count(e) AS companies_act_nodes

question: What is the circular number of the FPI Master Circular?
verify_cypher: MATCH (e:Entity {name:'FPI Master Circular'}) RETURN e.number AS number, e.aliases AS aliases

question: On which page does the FPI KYC review circular cite the SEBI Act, 1992?
verify_cypher: MATCH (c:Circular)-[:CONTAINS]->(cl:Clause)-[]->(:Entity {name:'Securities and Exchange Board of India Act, 1992'}) WHERE c.id ENDS WITH '24814/2026' RETURN DISTINCT cl.page_number AS page

question: Which documents are cited by both the FPI KYC review circular and the FPI digital Power of Attorney circular?
expected: The SEBI Act, 1992; the SEBI (Foreign Portfolio Investors) Regulations, 2019; and the FPI Master Circular (May 30, 2024).
verify_cypher: MATCH (a:Circular)-[:CONTAINS]->(:Clause)-[]->(e:Entity)<-[]-(:Clause)<-[:CONTAINS]-(b:Circular) WHERE a.id ENDS WITH '24814/2026' AND b.id ENDS WITH '19251/2026' RETURN DISTINCT e.name AS document
